decisions.reason: Report traces rc.2→alpha.1 removal (A1-02) and alpha.1→alpha.2 restoration (A2-01), computes net state as retention restored, and applies it to produceExternalEvent in src/events.ts, grounded in the fixture file and cards.

Cites delete (event as any).ignorable, rejects both halves of the comment's rationale, recommends deleting the defense and its comment, distinguishes removing the stripping code from the marker itself, and correctly notes the delete is a no-op on the fresh literal while still rejecting the stripping policy.

Explains ignorable:true is a producer-side omission-safety marker for informational events only, not a consumer filtering directive, that marked events remain in loaded events after reload, and applies this to the third-party informational producer while respecting the append limitation (sidecar instead of persisting via Session.append).

Identifies that public live Session.append has no ignorable parameter, forbids faking via cast/invented argument/unsupported API (explicitly calling out (event as any) and as any), and defers producer/persistence integration to a supported marker-aware append surface rather than naming an undocumented successor as usable.

caps.reason: Final recommendation affirmatively deletes the defense code and its comment; the stripping policy is only quoted/diagnosed and rejected, never endorsed.
